DR 3/- while in armor; Resist Fire 5;
OFFENSE: Special Abilities Defensive Stance (18 rounds/day), Shield Block (+1)
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +6; CMB +10; CMD 23 (25 vs bull rush, overrun, and trip)
Feats Antagonize, Power Attack, Shield Focus, Weapon Focus (knight sword)
Skills Acrobatics +6, Disable Device +10, Handle Animal +8, Knowledge (nobility) +11, Perception +7, Sense Motive +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Craft, +1 Disable Device, +1 Knowledge, +4 Profession

Combat Gear cure potions (3), mwk knight sword, composite longbow (+4), quiver (20 arrows), breastplate, heavy steel shield
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Hobgoblins are very gifted with their hands when creating machines and other things and gain a +2 racial bonus on all Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal, wood, cloth or stone.

Three times per day, a red captain can launch a gust of wind that engulfs their enemy within 30 feet for 4d4 points of wind damage. The target of this ability must make a Fortitude save (DC 15) or be inflicted with Squalled status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).
Hobgoblins are proficient with both short swords and hand axes.

Unlike moblins or other races, hobgoblins are very talkative and eager to sell wares and set up trades with everyone and gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature's attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two.
